decisions.reason: The assessment-date and vehicle-identity presentation refinements do not change the required editable source formats, report variants, PDF export support, or general future-editability obligation.
The source Requirement's date and vehicle-identity refinements do not change the dashboard's score fields, heading, prominence, or communication goal.
Changing the presentation of the assessment date and vehicle identity does not alter the required fonts, icons, design assets, or their handoff purpose.
The customer-field refinements are independent of the content and scannable presentation of the front-page result explanation.
The assessment-date and vehicle-identity decisions do not change the requirement to use RR-01 consistently rather than PR-01.
The source refinements do not necessarily alter the separately specified subtle internal-page header or its suggested content; message 42 already contains a dedicated header decision.
The broad visual-style Requirement already has its own same-message refinement, while the customer-field display choices do not require an additional change to its current attributes.
The source does not state that the assessment-date placeholder or vehicle-group section is in the footer, so propagating those field refinements to the footer would require unsupported inference.
The customer-field display refinements do not affect the final-page confidentiality warning's presence, visual treatment, or message clarity.
The assessment-date and vehicle-identity presentation choices do not change report-variant selection or the mapping of scores to risk and exposure bands.
